name: cino-academy
description: Private Academy: assessment-aware research, verified evidence, critical arguments, personal voice and independent revisions.

interface.longDescription: Cino Academy has six focused skills for permitted university research and writing: assessment and rubric interpretation, essay and argument planning, scholarly discovery, literature synthesis, precise citation and source verification, natural genre-specific writing and a separately reviewed revision process. Sources and AI permissions are not invented; a DOI match alone never proves a research claim. Optional personal writing profiles stay outside the distributed plugin. It has no built-in scholarly database or connected writing service.
defaultPrompt: Check my assignment brief and marking criteria before giving advice.
Challenge my argument and identify what the evidence actually proves.
Check the references in my draft and preserve my genuine writing style.

publication.release_notes: 1.3.0: assignment-specific modes, source/claim evidence ledger, Business & Management argument workshop, verified author-edit voice guidance, independent revision receipts, submission preflight and synthetic QA. Six skills; no new network service or personal dataset.
